tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All conditions as per Tender Documents

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss statement duly attested by the Chartered Accountant for 4 years 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25.
Company EMail ID and Phone No
Documentary Evidence for Place of Business

Financial Turnover Statements for the years 2021-22 2022-23 2023-24 and 2024-25 as on 31st March issued by a Chartered Accountant on their official letterhead mentioning the UDIN number with an average annual turnover not less than Rs2 crore
GST Registration Certificate and GST Returns from May-2025 to October- 2025 paid receipt
List of quoted books as per annexure-1 Author, Title, Edition

Name of the Tendering Firm with full address and Photograph of the Tenderer. The photograph of the tenderer authorized signatory must be affixed with the application. Tenders submitted without the enclosed photograph will be summarily rejected.
Registration certificate of establishment / registered office / branch office in the Karnataka state issued by appropriate authority
Self-declaration in stamp paper of Rs.100 stating that the tendering firm is not blacklisted by Central State Government or by semi Government Organization Medical Institutions.
Self-Declaration on stamp paper stating that Successful tenderer will submit Security Deposit of 5 percent on tender value.

Tenderers who have supplied books to KOIMS in the past shall upload produce the latest satisfactory supply certificate issued by the Director, KOIMS, Madikeri. The certificate shall be obtained between the date of notification of tender and the closing date of tender

The bidder must provide a valid membership renewal certificate from the federation of publishers & booksellers association of India FPBAI for the last Five 5 consecutive years and current renewal certificate must be

The bidder must provide a valid membership renewal certificate from the federation of publishers booksellers association of India FPBAI for the last five consecutive years and Karnataka Governement Health Sciences Librarians Association certificate must be submitted www.kghsla.org

The bidder shall furnish documentary evidence demonstrating successful supply of medical books to a minimum of four 04 Government Medical Institutions in Karnataka in each of the following financial years
